title: Unit – 2 : Session – 3 : SLO – 1 | Switch Statements
sections: 1) Menu: switch (option) { case 1: System.out.println("New File"); break; case 2: System.out.println("Open File"); break; case 3: System.out.println("Save File"); break; default: System.out.println("Invalid Option"); }  → prints Open File.

2) Grade: switch (grade) { case 'A': System.out.println("Excellent"); break; case 'B': System.out.println("Good"); break; case 'C': System.out.println("Average"); break; default: System.out.println("Fail"); }  → prints Good.

3) Day: switch (day) { case 1: System.out.println("Monday"); break; case 2: System.out.println("Tuesday"); break; case 3: System.out.println("Wednesday"); break; case 4: System.out.println("Thursday"); break; case 5: System.out.println("Friday"); break; default: System.out.println("Invalid Day"); }  → prints Friday.
